ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, $\angle ACD$ is the angle subtended by arc $AD$ on the circumference, $\angle ACD=30^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle DAB$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect BD, \\
$\because$ AB is the diameter of the circle, \\
$\therefore \angle ADB=90^\circ$, \\
$\because \angle ACD=\angle B=30^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle DAB=90^\circ-\angle B=90^\circ-30^\circ=\boxed{60^\circ}$.
